facts.fact: Tamsin 走到 Carlinsrest 时已是傍晚，一路留心找那个老人和他妻子。
facts.anchor: By the time I got to Carlinsrest, it was late afternoon.

facts.fact: 她逼自己先去五金杂货店还钥匙，指望抢在 Rowan 之前回到店里。
facts.anchor: I forced myself back toward the hardware and supplies store, hoping I’d beaten Rowan back down.

facts.fact: Fergus 看到只剩钥匙，问她卡车剩下的部分在哪。
facts.anchor: “Where’s the rest of the truck?” he asked.

facts.fact: 她撒谎说忘了钥匙在身上，说完自觉像个懦夫。
facts.anchor: “I had to leave. Forgot I had them with me,” I said and felt like a coward.

facts.fact: Fergus 在她要走时叫住她，问那栋闹鬼的房子怎么样了。
facts.anchor: “How are you getting on with your haunted house?”

facts.fact: Fergus 说那个转学来的男孩右脸有一块葡萄酒色胎记。
facts.anchor: A port wine stain, I think it’s called.

facts.fact: 躲在浴室门后的妈妈无声地告诉她：屋里有东西。
几周后男孩回来了，胎记没了，说他把胎记改掉了，好让妈妈安全。
facts.anchor: ‘I changed it,’ he said, ‘so Mum could be safe.’

facts.fact: Fergus 承认整段故事是编的，专门耍她，随后笑到露出整排牙。
facts.anchor: “Got you,” he said. “Got you proper that time.”

facts.fact: Rowan 进门后，Fergus 当面说她好骗。
facts.anchor: “Your new pal is a gullible one.”
